Amazing Good Food, Low Cost and Excellent Service
Sep 2026 • Family
Next to our hotel (Balcona Hotel) along My Khe beach is this Ăn Thôi Hải Sản restaurant which has high reviews. Taking an elderly to a nice restaurant dinner with a minute walk is the most reasonable choice. 
Staff were most hospitable at the door and we didn’t make any reservations but were led to an available table quickly. Large restaurant, nice decor and fan cooled. Waiter came to explain the menu and pointed out credit card fee charges. 
Seafood restaurants were plentiful in Danang so I was cynical. First dish was Stir Fried Razor Clam & Morning Glory and this won me over! Fried Pho with Seafood & Pollack Roe was delicious. Prawn in Garlic Butter Sauce was a pampering experience when the staff carefully peeled every prawn in front of you. The sauce was gorgeous, served with baguette. Grilled Abalone in Scallion Oil was last - it was quite amazing to me because it’s so inexpensive. 
Two highlights in my dinner experience are (1) food was great and economically priced (2) staff were attentive and they provide good service. 
I have decided to spend the next 2 remaining days to have dinner there again.
